newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Westinghouse raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Westinghouse raised to buy.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Thursday it raised its rating on the shares of Westinghouse Electric Corp to buy from neutral, with a 12-month price target of $31 per share.
-- Analyst Timothy Wallace said his 1997 after-tax cash flow estimate was $0.53 per share and his 1998 after-tax cash flow estimate was $1.03 per share.
-- Wallace said he was upgrading his rating on the shares because he was very impressed with Westinghouse's revised separation plan, calling it more creative.
-- The restructuring team at Westinghouse's CBS unit had an outstanding track record, he said.
-- The CBS's prime-time schedule looked impressive and the network had ratings momentum, he said.
-- Wallace said the company's radio and outdoor business, which was the source of half its cash flow, was very strong.
